technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Boot and Spring Cloud Stream/Data as base frameworks.
For dependency resolution (U2), implement a custom version resolver using Maven Aether or similar library to mediate jar versions at runtime.
For undeploy operation (U5), leverage existing Spring Cloud Data deploy lifecycle and implement inverse logic for single JVM mode.
For profiles support (U6), use Spring @Profile annotations and conditional bean definitions to switch between in-memory and other backends.
For counter endpoints (U8), use Micrometer and Spring Boot Actuator to expose metrics as REST endpoints.
For Docker publishing (U3), use a standard Dockerfile and automate push via CI script (e.g., GitHub Actions).
For screencast (U4), use OBS for recording and basic video editing tools.
All development will be done in Java 17+ as required by Spring Framework 6.0.
assumptions: The developer is experienced with Spring Cloud ecosystem and Java development.
Existing project setup (build files, repository structure) is already in place.
All required dependencies (Spring libraries, Docker, etc.) are available without additional setup time.
Screencast creation does not require external approval or extensive review.
The PR referenced in U5 (https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-data/pull/19) provides sufficient context and examples.
No significant integration or regression issues arise from implementing any single user story.
Effort estimates include analysis, coding, unit testing, and documentation within each activity.

activities.activity_name: Investigate msg bus binding jar inclusion/exclusion
activities.activity_description: Research and implement mechanism to include or exclude message bus and binding jars, define fallback when no binding is configured. Covers U1.

activities.activity_name: Implement dependency resolution for version conflicts
activities.activity_description: Add support to resolve jar version conflicts between modules at runtime, ensuring correct bits are used. Covers U2.

activities.activity_name: Publish s-c-d Docker image to DockerHub
activities.activity_description: Set up Docker build, tag, and push pipeline for incremental commits. Covers U3.

activities.activity_name: Create public screencast of firehose|counter pipe
activities.activity_description: Plan, record, edit, and publish a screencast demonstrating the firehose to counter pipe in Spring Cloud Stream. Covers U4.
Develop the undeploy functionality for single JVM mode, ensuring consistent strategy for both jobs and streams. Covers U5.

activities.activity_name: Add profiles support to Admin application
activities.activity_description: Implement Spring profiles (e.g., local, dev) in the core Admin app to back stream repository with different strategies. Covers U6.

activities.activity_name: Design foundation to port XD modules as s-c-s modules
activities.activity_description: Brainstorm and document the architectural foundation for migrating Spring XD modules to Spring Cloud Stream modules. Covers U7.
Add REST endpoints to expose counter metrics, e.g., for firehose|counter pipe, using Actuator and Micrometer. Covers U8.
